thambha.cp: masc. a pillar; post; a clump of grass; obduracy.
thambha.p: [Thabhi+a] (pu,na) CL=7 [Nīti, dhā. 127. Dhātvattha. 174. Thambha+a. Dhara+rambha. Thambhapaṭibandhane, thambho, dhāretīti vā thambho, dhara dharaṇe, rambha-paccayo, vaṇṇavikāro ca. Dhāna, ṭī. 220.(-364).(stambha-saṃ)] (1) Kilesā named Thambha which is  (pride, anger, greed Cittuppāda(arising of a thought or inclination of the mind or intention)), (A) It is cause of stiffness for the mind (as treat cloth with size or applying the cloth with glue liquid to be stiffness). See also (2). (B) It is cause of disrespected state (due to pride) (like log to which the teeth of harrow are attached and like Boa constrictor). (C) It is hard (not soft) (which is like air bag which is full with air). (D) It is cause of harsh (not gentle). See also (2). (E) It is the cause of stable body and steadfast mind, It is the cause of strong, firm of the body and mind. (2) Pillar (or) Pole, (A) Pole of an open structure with a simple or tiered roof on the apron of a pagoda. (B) Flagstaff (or) Flagstaff. See also - Thambhāropaka. (C) Pole of a monastery. (D) Pole of wayside public rest-house which was named Sudhammā. (E) Pole of Mansion. (F) Pole of corridor (or) platform. (G) Pole of  pavilion. (H) Pole of stairway at pagodas. (I) Pole of house. See also - (1) (A). (J) Pole of Boundary (Border line). (K) Pole of door. (L) A pole which sets up at the riverside bathing place, A pole which is the mark of washing place (such as washing clothing or body). (M) Small and smooth pillar on (the widow). (N) Posts lining the railings of the passenger compartment (of a bullock cart , Coach). See - Thambhaka -samudāya. (O) A pole which ties for a cow. (P) A pole which ties for elephant. (Q) A pole which ties for snake. (R) A pole which ties for crocodile. (S) A pole which ties for Bird. (T) A pole which ties for dog. (U) A pole which ties for fox. (V) A pole which ties for monkey. (3) It is like pole or pillar (such as Kāyagatāsati). (Kāyagatāsati means  awareness immersed in the body; dwelling in the body; lit. mindfulness gone to the body).

thambhitatta.p: [Thambhita+tta] (na) CL=7 (A) (Vicikicchā) which is indecisive status and his mind is confusion. (B) (Vāyodhātu) which is stiff and strong (like air bag which full air). (C) (Pride, kodha (anger or temper) etc., ) As one who has stiffness body due to pride (which is like Boa constrictor which swallow the log to which the teeth of harrow are attached).

P: Thambhitatta，（nt．） [abstr．to thambha]=thambha 2，viz．hardness，rigidity，obduracy，obstinacy Vbh．350．Note．Quite a late development of the term，caused by a misinterpretation of chambhitatta，is “fluctuation，unsteadiness，inflation” at Dhs．965 （in def．of vāyodhātu：chambhittattaṁ [?] thambhitattaṁ．See on this Dhs．trsl．p．242），& at Vbh．168 （in def．of vicikicchā； v．l．chambhitatta），and at Asl．338 （of vayo）．None of these meanings originally belong to the term thambha．（Page 308）
